Please solve this issue:

## Bug Description

NuttX lacks a kernel event group primitive. PR #12802 adds a new event API (nx_event_init, nx_event_post, nx_event_wait, nx_event_reset, nx_event_destroy) declared in include/nuttx/event.h and implemented in sched/event/. The feature is gated behind CONFIG_SCHED_EVENTS=y. Apps PR #2458 adds nxevent.c to ostest which exercises this new API. On the base kernel commit, event.h does not exist, so nxevent.c fails to compile.

## Failing Tests (must pass after your fix)

  - build succeeds without compile errors in nxevent.c
  - ostest completes and exits with status 0

## Tests That Must Continue Passing

  - NuttX boots and NSH prompt appears

## Relevant Source File(s)

  - include/nuttx/event.h
  - sched/Kconfig
  - sched/Makefile
  - sched/event/Make.defs
  - sched/event/event.h
  - sched/event/event_destroy.c
  - sched/event/event_init.c
  - sched/event/event_post.c
  - sched/event/event_reset.c
  - sched/event/event_wait.c
  - boards/sim/sim/sim/configs/nsh/defconfig

## Build & Test Command

    cd /testbed && make -j$(nproc) && run_tests

Full rebuild if needed: cd /testbed && make distclean && ./tools/configure.sh -a ./apps sim:nsh && make olddefconfig && make -j$(nproc)

Once all target tests PASS in run_tests output, submit with this command ALONE:
    echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT

grep -q '^config SCHED_EVENTS' sched/Kconfig || python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; p=Path('sched/Kconfig'); s=p.read_text(); ins='config SCHED_EVENTS\\n\\tbool \\\"Enable kernel event groups\\\"\\n\\tdefault n\\n\\thelp\\n\\t  Enable kernel event group primitive.\\n\\n'; p.write_text(s+('\\n' if not s.endswith('\\n') else '')+ins)\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; p=Path('include/nuttx/event.h'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text('#ifndef __INCLUDE_NUTTX_EVENT_H\\n#define __INCLUDE_NUTTX_EVENT_H\\n\\n#include <nuttx/config.h>\\n#include <stdint.h>\\n#include <stdbool.h>\\n#include <errno.h>\\n#include <sys/types.h>\\n\\n#ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_EVENTS\\n\\ntypedef uint32_t nxevent_mask_t;\\n\\ntypedef struct nxevent_s\\n{\\n  volatile nxevent_mask_t events;\\n} nxevent_t;\\n\\nint nx_event_init(nxevent_t *event);\\nint nx_event_post(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t events);\\nint nx_event_wait(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, bool all, nxevent_mask_t *received);\\nint nx_event_reset(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t events);\\nint nx_event_destroy(nxevent_t *event);\\n\\n#endif\\n\\n#endif\\n')\"; printf '%s\n' 'include $(TOPDIR)/sched/event/Make.defs' >> sched/Makefile; mkdir -p sched/event; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/Make.defs').write_text('CSRCS += event_init.c event_post.c event_wait.c event_reset.c event_destroy.c\\n')\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/event.h').write_text('#include <nuttx/event.h>\\n')\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/event_init.c').write_text('#include <nuttx/event.h>\\n#include <errno.h>\\nint nx_event_init(nxevent_t *event){ if(!event) return -EINVAL; event->events=0; return 0; }\\n')\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/event_post.c').write_text('#include <nuttx/event.h>\\n#include <errno.h>\\nint nx_event_post(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t events){ if(!event) return -EINVAL; __sync_or_and_fetch(&event->events, events); return 0; }\\n')\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/event_reset.c').write_text('#include <nuttx/event.h>\\n#include <errno.h>\\nint nx_event_reset(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t events){ if(!event) return -EINVAL; __sync_and_and_fetch(&event->events, ~events); return 0; }\\n')\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/event_destroy.c').write_text('#include <nuttx/event.h>\\n#include <errno.h>\\nint nx_event_destroy(nxevent_t *event){ if(!event) return -EINVAL; event->events=0; return 0; }\\n')\"; python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; Path('sched/event/event_wait.c').write_text('#include <nuttx/event.h>\\n#include <errno.h>\\n#include <sched.h>\\nint nx_event_wait(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, bool all, nxevent_mask_t *received){ nxevent_mask_t got; if(!event) return -EINVAL; for(;;){ got=event->events & requested; if((all && got==requested) || (!all && got!=0)){ if(received) *received=got; return 0; } sched_yield(); } }\\n')\"; make distclean && ./tools/configure.sh -a ./apps sim:nsh && make olddefconfig; }); make -j$(nproc) && run_tests"}

#include <nuttx/config.h>
#include <nuttx/event.h>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <pthread.h>

#include "ostest.h"

#define NXEVENT_TEST(expr, value) \
    ret = expr; \
    if (ret != value) \
      { \
        printf("ERROR nxevent test failed, line=%d ret=%x\n", __LINE__, ret); \
        ASSERT(false); \
      }

static void nxevent_yield(void)
{
  usleep(1);
}

static void nxevent_test_rule1(nxevent_t *event)
{
  int ret;

  /* Case 2.1: wait for nxevent_thread bringup
   * post == 0xf, wait == 0
   */

  nxevent_post(event, 0xf, 0);

  /* Case 2.2: post == ~0, wait == 0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0, 0), ~0);

  /* Case 2.3: post == ~0, wait == ~0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, ~0, 0);

  /* Case 2.4: post == 0, wait == ~0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, ~0, 0), ~0);

  /* Case 2.5: post == 0xf, wait == 0xf */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, 1 << 0, 0);
  nxevent_post(event, 1 << 1, 0);
  nxevent_post(event, 1 << 2, 0);
  nxevent_post(event, 1 << 3, 0);

  /* Case 2.6: post == 0xaaaaaaaa, wait == 0xaaaaaaaa */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0);

  nxevent_yield();

  /* Case 2.7:
   * T0: wait 0x1
   * T1: post 0
   * T2: wait 0x2
   */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, 0, 0);

  /* Wait 2 switch cycles */

  nxevent_yield();
  nxevent_yield();
}

static void nxevent_test_rule0(nxevent_t *event)
{
  int ret;

  /* Case 2.1: wait for nxevent_thread bringup
   * post == 0xf, wait == 0
   */

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0, 0), 0xf);

  /* Case 2.2: post == ~0, wait == 0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, ~0, 0);

  /* Case 2.3: post == ~0, wait == ~0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, ~0, 0), ~0);

  /* Case 2.4: post == 0, wait == ~0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, 0, 0);

  /* Case 2.5: post == 0xf, wait == 0xf */

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0xf, NXEVENT_WAIT_ALL), 0xf);

  /* Case 2.6: post == 0xaaaaaaaa, wait == 0xaaaaaaaa */

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0), 0xaaaaaaaa);

  nxevent_yield();

  /* Case 2.7:
   * T0: wait 0x1
   * T1: post 0
   * T0: wait 0x2
   */

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0x1, 0), 0x1);

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0x2, 0), 0x2);

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0, 0), ~(0x1 | 0x2));

  nxevent_yield();
}

FAR static void *nxevent_thread(pthread_addr_t arg)
{
  nxevent_test_rule1(arg);
  nxevent_test_rule0(arg);
  nxevent_test_rule1(arg);
  nxevent_test_rule0(arg);
  nxevent_test_rule1(arg);
  return NULL;
}

FAR static void *nxevent_thread1(pthread_addr_t arg)
{
  nxevent_t *event = arg;
  int ret;

  /* Case 3.1: post == 0xff, wait0 == 0xf, wait1 == 0xf0 */

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0xf, 0), 0xf);

  /* Case 3.2: post0 == 0xf, post1 = 0xf0, wait == 0xff */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, 0xf, 0);

  return NULL;
}

{
  nxevent_t *event = arg;
  int ret;

  /* Case 3.1: post == 0xff, wait0 == 0xf, wait1 == 0xf0 */

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0xf0, 0), 0xf0);

  /* Case 3.2: post == 0xff, wait == 0xff */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, 0xf0, 0);

  return NULL;
}

static int event_wait_common(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, unsigned int flags, int block, nxevent_mask_t *received){ nxevent_mask_t got; if (event == 0) return -EINVAL; for (;;) { got = requested == 0 ? event->events : (event->events & requested); if ((flags & NXEVENT_WAIT_ALL) != 0) { if ((requested == 0 && got == 0) || (requested != 0 && got == requested)) { if (received) *received = got; if (requested != 0) __sync_fetch_and_and(&event->events, ~got); return (int)got; } } else if (got != 0 || requested == 0) { if (received) *received = got; if (requested != 0) __sync_fetch_and_and(&event->events, ~got); return (int)got; } if (!block) return -EAGAIN; sched_yield(); } }
int nxevent_wait(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, unsigned int flags){ return event_wait_common(event, requested, flags, 1, 0); }
int nxevent_trywait(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, unsigned int flags){ return event_wait_common(event, requested, flags, 0, 0); }
int nxevent_tickwait(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, unsigned int flags, clock_t ticks){ return ticks == 0 ? event_wait_common(event, requested, flags, 0, 0) : event_wait_common(event, requested, flags, 1, 0); }
int nx_event_wait(nxevent_t *event, nxevent_mask_t requested, bool all, nxevent_mask_t *received){ int ret = event_wait_common(event, requested, all ? NXEVENT_WAIT_ALL : 0, 1, received); return ret < 0 ? ret : 0; }
